text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on, Trainer...
You really should stop—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I get it now.
So that's how you felt earlier.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's not do this after all, Trainer.
—I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Sore losers like us need to know when to walk away from this game!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's head home...
...before my wallet suffers irreversible damage!
It ended in a disappointing result...
